scrabble.title: Scrabble · Web Edition
scrabble.description: Word game powered by a C++17 rules engine adapted for the browser with WebAssembly. Features a 15 × 15 board, bonus squares, and local games for 2–4 players.
scrabble.outcome: Playable on GitHub Pages, sharing its rules engine between console and browser, with tests covering both versions.
scrabble.problem: Bring an academic C++ word game to the browser without duplicating its rules engine.
scrabble.contribution: Built the C++ game engine, integrated Emscripten and WebAssembly, and developed a responsive web interface.
scrabble.imageAlt: Scrabble Web Edition screenshot showing a 15 × 15 board with bonus squares and a local multiplayer new-game form.

distributedLibrary.title: Distributed Library Platform
distributedLibrary.description: Distributed architecture with four microfrontends, independent microservices, and persistence in PostgreSQL, Cloudflare D1, and Turso.
distributedLibrary.problem: Integrate book, author, publisher, and review modules running as independent services.
distributedLibrary.contribution: Built and integrated web interfaces, serverless endpoints, independent databases, and cross-entity navigation.
distributedLibrary.outcome: Academic platform deployed with an integration shell and individually published services.
distributedLibrary.imageAlt: Preview of the distributed library platform integrated through its web application shell.

bookstore.title: Bookstore · RabbitMQ
bookstore.description: Distributed catalog with reads from MongoDB and asynchronous writes through RabbitMQ queues, built with Vue 3 and serverless functions.
bookstore.problem: Manage books, authors, and publishers without tightly coupling writes to direct database persistence.
bookstore.contribution: Integrated Vue interfaces, Netlify Functions endpoints, three entity queues, and task processors.
bookstore.outcome: Published application with an independent API, asynchronous messaging, and MongoDB Atlas persistence.

petshop.title: Huellita PetShop
petshop.description: Responsive web application for organizing a pet product catalog with clear navigation and a consistent experience across screen sizes.
petshop.outcome: Published site with clearer structure, simple navigation and consistent mobile/desktop experience.
petshop.problem: A static catalog needed stronger visual hierarchy, product organization and simple navigation.
petshop.contribution: Responsive layout, section structure, reusable visual components and GitHub Pages publishing.
